attachment_parent_check.name: attachment_parent_check
attachment_parent_check.value: ("report_attachments"."report_id" is not null)::integer + ("report_attachments"."draft_id" is not null)::integer = 1

reports_handler_category_check.name: reports_handler_category_check
reports_handler_category_check.value: ("reports"."category" = 'kehilangan-temuan' and "reports"."handler_role" = 'satpam') or ("reports"."category" = 'fasilitas' and "reports"."handler_role" = 'teknisi') or ("reports"."category" in ('layanan', 'lainnya') and "reports"."handler_role" = 'manajemen')

reports_status_category_check.name: reports_status_category_check
reports_status_category_check.value: "reports"."status" in ('baru', 'diproses', 'selesai', 'ditolak') or ("reports"."category" in ('kehilangan-temuan', 'fasilitas') and "reports"."status" = 'diverifikasi') or ("reports"."category" = 'kehilangan-temuan' and "reports"."status" in ('barang_teridentifikasi', 'diserahkan'))
